summary: Job template filters: surveyEnabled omitted syncs all templates, true only those with surveys enabled, false only those without; labels empty or omitted syncs all, otherwise templates with any listed label (OR logic, case-insensitive).
questions: How do I sync only job templates with surveys to the portal?
Are portal label filters AND or OR?
Is label matching case-sensitive in portal sync?

answer_card.title: Portal job template filters
answer_card.answer_md:
**surveyEnabled**
- omitted: all job templates
- `true`: only templates with a survey enabled
- `false`: only templates without a survey

**labels**
- `[]` or omitted: all job templates
- `["label1", "label2"]`: templates with **any** of the labels (OR)
- matching is case-insensitive
